==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=NServiceBus&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Verify.NServiceBus: a recording context is written as the sends, publishes, replies and
        // forwards it saw, with deterministic message, conversation and correlation ids.
        // captureLogs defaults to true and only initializes Verify.MicrosoftLogging when that has
        // not already run, so passing it changes nothing: the package depends on it either way.
        VerifyNServiceBus.Initialize();
        // VerifyNServiceBus.AddSharedHeader("sharedKey", "sharedValue");

        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/NServiceBusTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=NServiceBus&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using VerifyTests.NServiceBus;

// Verify.NServiceBus: Snapshots what an NServiceBus handler or saga sent, published, replied and forwarded, with stable ids.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.NServiceBus
// Note: Initialize(captureLogs: true) is the default, and it only initializes
// Verify.MicrosoftLogging when that has not already run, so the parameter has no effect on the
// generated code.
// Note: The package depends on Verify.MicrosoftLogging, so log entries are recorded under log
// whichever way the plugins are initialized.
// Note: Deterministic message, conversation and correlation ids are registered as named guids,
// which is what keeps the snapshots stable.
// Note: VerifyNServiceBus.AddSharedHeaders(...) in the module initializer adds headers to every
// recorded message.
// Note: RecordingInvokeHandlerContext, RecordingIncomingPhysicalMessageContext and
// RecordingMessageSession cover the other pipeline stages.
// Note: The package targets net10.0 only.
public class NServiceBusTests
{
    // RecordingHandlerContext is a test double for IMessageHandlerContext. Verifying it after
    // the handler has run covers every message the handler produced, in one file.
    // No transport, endpoint or broker is started.
    [Fact]
    public async Task HandlerContext()
    {
        var handler = new MyHandler();
        var context = new RecordingHandlerContext();

        var message = new MyRequest();
        await handler.Handle(message, context);

        await Verify(context);
    }

    // With a recording running, the interactions are appended to whatever is verified instead
    // of being the thing verified, which suits a test whose subject is something else.
    [Fact]
    public async Task Recording()
    {
        Recording.Start();
        var handler = new MyHandler();
        var context = new RecordingHandlerContext();

        await handler.Handle(new MyRequest(), context);

        await Verify("some other data");
    }

    // The map pairs every message type with the handlers that take it, so a message that
    // nobody handles shows up as a diff rather than as a message that silently goes nowhere.
    [Fact]
    public Task MessageToHandlerMap()
    {
        var map = new MessageToHandlerMap();
        map.AddMessagesFromAssembly<MyRequest>();
        map.AddHandlersFromAssembly<MyHandler>();
        return Verify(map);
    }
}
